calls.statement:
SELECT m.home_store_id, count(*) AS rows_current, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members, min(m.join_date) AS first_join, max(m.join_date) AS last_join, count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.valid_to <> DATE '9999-12-31') AS bad_valid_to
FROM dim_member m
WHERE m.is_current AND (m.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999) OR m.home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS current_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS current_members, count(*) FILTER (WHERE join_date IS NULL) AS null_join, max(join_date) AS latest_join, (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS latest_sale
FROM dim_member

calls.statement:
WITH tampere_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM dim_member AS m
  JOIN dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
  WHERE m.is_current AND s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.store_id < 900
),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dm.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line AS f
  JOIN dim_member AS dm ON dm.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store AS st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product AS p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
    AND st.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
ever AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS n
  FROM dim_member AS m JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
  WHERE s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.store_id < 900
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM tampere_members) AS tampere_members,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM tampere_members t JOIN active a USING (member_id)) AS tampere_active_52w,
       (SELECT n FROM ever) AS tampere_any_version
